guarantees.claim: For i from 0 to NumWordsPrefix-1, reg_ns_prefix[32*i+:32] is driven by reg2hw.prefix[i].q in a combinational loop.

assumptions.claim: NumWordsPrefix is assumed to be greater than 0; the block relies on at least one iteration to drive reg_ns_prefix.
assumptions.risk: If NumWordsPrefix is 0, reg_ns_prefix is not assigned by this always_comb block, potentially causing latch inference or undefined value.

uncertain_points.claim: If NumWordsPrefix * 32 exceeds the declared width of reg_ns_prefix, or if NumWordsPrefix exceeds the dimension of reg2hw.prefix array, the part-select assignment will access out-of-bounds, causing synthesis/elaboration failure or data corruption.
uncertain_points.risk: compilation failure or functional data misrouting in a security‑critical prefix path.

uncertain_points.claim: It is unclear whether NumWordsPrefix = 0 is a legal configuration and, if so, whether another chunk provides a default assignment to reg_ns_prefix to prevent incomplete assignment in this always_comb block.
uncertain_points.risk: Latch inference or simulation X‑propagation on reg_ns_prefix, potentially affecting downstream KMAC operation.
